newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel says debt terms talks advancing.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel says debt terms talks advancing.

text.p: Eurotunnel SA/Plc, the British-French operator of the tunnel under the English Channel, said Wednesday that talks on restructuring its debt with a banking consortium were making progress but were not yet completed.
"Our conversations with the banks are continuing and advancing very well but we cannot confirm at the moment that we have reached an agreement," a Eurotunnel spokeswoman said.

Participating banks confirmed that there had been progress in the talks aimed at restructuring the tunnel operator's nine billion pounds ($14.6 billion) of debt but said the outcome was as yet uncertain.
The Financial Times reported Wednesday that the steering committee of leading bankers had agreed on final terms.
But a banking source said: "I think that's a bit premature. It's not that simple."

The Eurotunnel spokeswoman said the tunnel operator could not speak for the banks but that in any case final terms would still have to be approved by other banks in the consortium as well as Eurotunnel's own board.
